1,200 repositories.

When we launched Patchwork CI, we promised it would stay free for open source. Plenty of people called that crazy. How would we make money?

Today we run on 1,200 repositories. About 900 are open source.

Here's what surprised me. Across all those repos, 1 in 7 CI failures was a flaky test. 1 in 7. That's hours of developer time burned on red builds that never broke anything.

Open source handed us users, data, feedback and a community. Our most-requested feature, GitLab support, came from OSS maintainers. We shipped it on November 12.

Giving back is strategy.
